title: Record Your Original Song in Nashville Studio
includes: Multiple instruments, vocals or songs (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
You record your own original song—not a cover, not karaoke. This is your music, captured in a real Nashville studio. You’ll work one-on-one with a professional sound engineer who will guide you through the process and help you sound your best.
The session takes place in a real working recording studio—this is where actual music gets made.
Whether you're an experienced musician or it’s your first time in a studio, our team makes the experience easy, welcoming, and personalized. You’ll leave with a recorded version of your own original work—something most people only dream of doing in Music City.
Perfect for songwriters, creatives, and anyone looking for a bucket-list experience in Nashville.

Regardless of your age or skill level, NASHVOX STUDIOS will make your unique song special.
